* {{cite news |last=Geddes |first=Bob |date=January 17, 2019 |title=US rapper Playboi Carti trashed tour bus and punched driver at Gretna services in diva strop |url=https://www.dailyrecord.co.uk/news/scottish-news/rapper-playboi-carti-trashed-tour-13871687 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190118022557/https://www.dailyrecord.co.uk/news/scottish-news/rapper-playboi-carti-trashed-tour-13871687 |archive-date=January 18, 2019 |access-date=March 7, 2024 |newspaper=[[Daily Record (Scotland)|Daily Record]]}} Reported 22 years old in January 2019, supporting a birth date of September 13, 1996.</ref>|name=Birth year citations}} known professionally as '''Playboi Carti''', is an American rapper. Known for his eccentric vocal style and fashion, he is considered an influential figure in modern [[hip-hop]] and a pioneer of the [[Rage (music genre)|rage]] microgenre. His music has been characterized as atmospheric and avant-garde, often marked by unconventional vocal techniques such as his "baby voice", with critics highlighting his focus on mood and persona over traditional lyricism. Aside from his recording career, Carter founded the record label and rap collective [[Opium (record label)|Opium]] in 2019, which has signed artists including [[Ken Carson]], [[Destroy Lonely]], [[Homixide Gang]], and fellow [[ASAP Mob]] member [[ASAP Nast]].

Born and raised in [[Atlanta]], Georgia, Carter began his musical career under the stage name '''Sir Cartier''' in 2011, [[self-releasing]] early tracks on [[SoundCloud]]. He signed with [[Awful Records]] in 2014 and later with [[ASAP Rocky]]'s AWGE imprint, a joint venture with [[Interscope Records]], in 2016. Carter gained mainstream attention with his [[Playboi Carti (mixtape)|eponymous debut mixtape]] (2017), which peaked at number 12 on the [[Billboard 200|''Billboard'' 200]] and produced the singles "[[Magnolia (Playboi Carti song)|Magnolia]]" and "[[Wokeuplikethis]]" (featuring [[Lil Uzi Vert]]). His debut studio album, ''[[Die Lit]]'' (2018), was met with commercial success, debuting at number three on the ''Billboard'' 200.

His second album, ''[[Whole Lotta Red]]'' (2020), became his first number-one album on the ''Billboard'' 200 and was later ranked among the greatest hip-hop albums by ''[[Rolling Stone]]''. After a series of high-profile collaborations, including [[Travis Scott]]'s "[[Fein (song)|Fein]]" (2023), [[The Weeknd]]'s "[[Timeless (The Weeknd and Playboi Carti song)|Timeless]]" (2024) and [[Kanye West]] and [[Ty Dolla Sign]]'s "[[Carnival (¥$ song)|Carnival]]" (2024) — the latter becoming his first number-one single on the [[Billboard Hot 100|''Billboard'' Hot 100]] — Carter released his third album, ''[[Music (Playboi Carti album)|Music]]'' (2025). The album received generally positive reviews and became his second consecutive number-one on the ''Billboard'' 200. It yielded the [[Promotional recording|promotional single]], "[[Evil J0rdan]]", which debuted at number two on the ''Billboard'' Hot 100.
